Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

abandon verb

a plan, an attempt or a habit: give up

also give up, drop, give up on, leave off

classical

Cic. Rep. 6.10: omitte timōrem (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Leg. 1.5: teneō quam optābam occāsiōnem neque omittam (Lewis & Short)

omittō, omittere, omīsī, omissum

verb, third conjugation: with the accusative, or the infinitive (“stop doing”)

give up, drop, let go

Let go of a plan, a fear, an opportunity; with an infinitive, “stop” (omitte mīrārī, Hor. C. 3.29.11). It also means “pass over, say nothing of” (ut alia omittam) (Lewis & Short).

Other words

  • dēpōnō, dēpōnere, dēposuī, dēpositum — lay aside, give up

    verb, third conjugation, with the accusative · also used · classical · Caes. BC 3.103: cōnsilium adeundae Sȳriae (Lewis & Short); Catull. 76.13: difficile est longum subitō dēpōnere amōrem

    Lay down, and so give up: a plan, a hope, a grudge, an office. Its first sense is “put down, set down” (see put), and it also means “deposit, entrust” (Lewis & Short).

  • dēsistō, dēsistere, dēstitī — give up (an attempt), leave off

    verb, third conjugation: with the ablative (with or without dē, ab) or the infinitive · also used · classical · Caes. BG 1.8: hōc cōnātū (Lewis & Short); Cic. Tusc. 2.28: dē sententiā dēstitistī (Lewis & Short)

    Stop trying, back down; for simply stopping, see stop.

Examples

  • omnia dēpōne, corporī servī

    drop everything and look after your healthCic. Fam. 16.4.4

  • difficile est longum subitō dēpōnere amōrem

    it is hard to give up a long love all at onceCatull. 76.13

  • teneō quam optābam occāsiōnem neque omittam

    I have the chance I wanted and I shan’t let it goCic. Leg. 1.5 (Lewis & Short)

  • quō factō nōn modo dēsistunt pugnā, sed etiam conferciunt sē lingentēs

    when that is done they not only give up fighting but crowd together, licking one anotherVarr. RR 3.16.35

See also abandon, stop, cancel.

SourcesLewis & Short: omitto · Lewis & Short: depono · Lewis & Short: desisto
